proposed.handling: Preserve loyalism and anti-reform reaction, Whig division over war, repression and trials, Catholic relief, war finance and the bank crisis, and naval mutiny as distinct explanatory demands with useful direct routes. Coherent parent subjects may group related demands, but their main meanings and reader-task questions must express the retained obligations. Mutiny is grievance-driven in this account; a general subversion claim is not established. Final parent/task fulfillment requires exact binding rather than a chapter association.

uncertainties.handling: Page 202 gives 5 April 1793; page 227 gives 6 April 1793. Retain the defection, its setting and political consequences without silently requiring one day as an externally corrected fact. Use April 1793 or qualify the competing supplied-source dates where the day matters.
